newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan holds Nigerian with heroin in tennis ball.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan holds Nigerian with heroin in tennis ball.

text.p: Pakistani customs authorities arrested a Nigerian man at Karachi airport on Monday for carrying 6.25 kg (13.7 lbs) of heroin concealed in tennis balls, a customs statement.
It said the Nigerian, named Innocent Nwaosu, was arrested before he could board a Pakistan International Airlines flight for Nairobi.

"His baggage consisting of a consignment of sports goods was subjected to thorough examination which yielded the recovery of 6.25 kg of heroin powder concealed in 145 tennis balls," the statement said.
